title: Switch with Econnex & Stay 45 Days for Cashback: Electricity $170, Gas $120, Broadband $120, Solar $200 @ TopCashback AU
body:
Deal: Switch with Econnex & Stay 45 Days for Cashback: Electricity $170, Gas $120, Broadband $120, Solar $200 @ TopCashback AU

[jessed] Spewin… Switched electricity yesterday for $110
[Lucille Bluth] You could have done this for $175 valid for another 6 days.
[bargaino] Reminds me, AGL still has not tracked cashback for my gas account from May. And they charged a nasty 'account fee', so time to cancel, and go back.
Are these guys any better than Shopback at chasing delinquent rebates?
[RolePlayer88] I did mine last time. And have not been paid after 6 months. Its a pain, but I am going through ACCC with these guys. Not worth the trouble with these guys.
[stripe] Bought this morning, took around 9 hours to track 👍
[jaboday423] Perth electricity supplier is synergy only, isn't it?
[Tyrx] The Econnex deals with TopCashback have a long history of unhappy users chasing payouts. A promised rebate is meaningless if customers have to fight to receive it. @tightarse Given the repeated complaints, it’s honestly surprising Econnex is still being permitted on TopCashback.
[Japius] I would but TopCashback and Superloop screwed me out of cashback already not sure I’m going to trust TCB for broadband again
[macmine] Unfortunately, this has been a negative experience for me.
Signed up on 14 March, never tracked. Raised ticket with TCB, only to get standard responses that it is sitting with Econnex for validation.
I've read on OZB it taking as long as 6 months for it to track and cash back recognised. It all seems questionable- as if the system is designed to keep you waiting for as long as possible, so that you won't port out, so that you hope to get paid.
I've on OZB read others having better luck tracking with ShopBack.
[jimbler] You port out as soon as you've completed the 30 or 45 days or whatever the T&C's required you to complete to be eligible. You don't stay connected with them for months and months until you get paid. That's crazy… If I'm required to stay 30 days for a deal, I'm signing up somewhere else for another deal on day 31.
